verification_method: Every worker claim inspected against live source. Runtime reproductions for accepted failure modes where practical. No claims accepted from worker status alone.

finding_decisions.reason: Retry rollback is not inherently required; retaining partial work can be correct.
Ordinary uncommitted stray changes conflict with clean-tree precondition; immutable baseline and gate-author checks still needed.
No requirement that orchestrator commit final changes; lack of commit is not independently a defect.

Source confirms whitespace override falls back; not promoted to main defect list.
